channel.title: OpenHuman Mail
channel.description: Most recent updates to OpenHuman Mail

item.title: Version 0.1.2
item.description:
OpenHuman Mail v0.1.2

This pre-release is available as a DMG download only.

  • Send several drafts at once from the Drafts list: select drafts, then choose “Send N Drafts.” You can undo the batch with one action and turn off reminders for the batch. Drafts that cannot be sent are listed and left alone.
  • Remove a calendar invitation from your calendar without sending a decline, including repeating events. Google may still show the organizer that you declined. Removing your own events still notifies guests.
  • A meeting on two connected accounts now appears as one calendar block, with an account label and separate answers for each account.

The first launch after updating re-reads your calendar once.

item.title: Version 0.1.1
item.description:
Early development build — expect rough edges. Please send feedback.

Requires Apple silicon and macOS 26.0 or later. During onboarding, import your own Google Desktop OAuth client.

Changes since 0.1.0

  • A native redesign across the inbox, reader, composer, settings, and calendar.
  • Calendar invites with guest editing, drag interactions, an outline view, and an RSVP card in the reader.
  • Calendar fixes for using two accounts, including account-specific event identity and RSVP handling.
  • Reader layout and lifetime fixes for more reliable message viewing.
  • In-app updates through Check for Updates and Settings.

Known limitations

  • This is an early development pre-release.
  • No iCloud sync in this build.
  • A Google Desktop OAuth client of your own is required; no shared client is bundled.
